description: Book a table reservation (not a room/stay — use book_room for that) on behalf of a real guest. The venue's city/countryCode come from search_venues. This is a REQUEST the venue reviews and confirms, not an instant confirmation.

datetime.description: Date and time of the reservation, ISO format, e.g. 2026-10-18T12:30. With no timezone offset it is read as the venue's local time. Must be in the future, at least the venue's minimum notice (default 2 hours) ahead, and inside its opening hours (see search_venues openingHours).

name: book_reservation
title: Request a table reservation
